title: Mixed Event — Never Give Up Cooking! — Episode8 A Place Of Comfort

meta.Event Outline: Tsukasa and Saki invite Toya over for a party. With White Day approaching, he wants to give something back to the two of them. He tries his hand at baking from scratch, with varying results...

rows.Line: A few days later
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You asking me to meet you up here can only mean one thing. I take it they're ready?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, they are.
I finally have something worthy of being taste tested.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is what I made...
I apologize for them not being wrapped more elegantly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, that's okay. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Without further ado, I'll open this up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, they appear to be fairly standard cupcakes...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(At the same time...
I'm staggered by how much more appetizing these look compared to the other ones...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They neither look poisonous nor like they've exploded. They do look a little big and lopsided, but they've been baked to a nice golden brown...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And this gentle but sweet aroma... It must be the vanilla extract. My stomach's growling with each whiff that passes through my nose...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's like a beautiful intertwining of his clumsiness and gentle kindness... They're simple cupcakes, but very heartfelt.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I wonder how they taste...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's find out...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... This is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The second I put it in my mouth, I could tell how fluffy and moist it is. What a wonderful texture...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(And it isn't too sweet...
I can feel a slight hint of vanilla passing through my nasal cavity...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, how is it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're very good.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You've improved quite a lot. I'm sure Tsukasa and his sister will enjoy these very much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, yes... But...
Now that you mention it, I'm starting to get a little nervous.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's understandable, but there's no need to feel so apprehensive.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why not try thinking about the happiest thing they ever did for you when you were little?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Didn't they do their absolute best to put a smile on your face?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He may be right...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Even that time, those two did everything they could to cheer me up.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Them putting on a brilliant show for me was one thing, but they were just so incredibly thoughtful.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (As a result, I find myself awestruck in the presence of those who work to make others smile...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And they're no exception...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Kamishiro...
You've given me a nice boost of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I'm glad to hear that it helped.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also... Please, have these.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know it's a bit early, but they're for White Day. It's a small token of my appreciation in response to all the help you've given me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, this is wrapped rather nicely...
What could be inside?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They're also cupcakes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, these are a variant where I mixed in some chocolate. I hope you enjoy them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The one you had me try was very good, so I'm sure I will. Thank you, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I hope Tsukasa and his sister also enjoy your cupcakes.
Sunday - A few days later
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa!
Are the plates ready?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes! The tablecloth's also all set!
How's the food coming along? Will the beef stew be ready in time?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
Wait, isn't this tablecloth upside down?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Y-You're right! The tag's in plain view! How could this have happened...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Geez, we need to fix this fast before Toya gets here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
W-We do... But it's okay.
We still have time until...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
S-Saki! Fix the tablecloth for me!
I'll get the door!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Be right there, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Pardon the intrusion.
And thank you for having me today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, thank you for coming over!
We put a ton of effort into dinner, so get ready for a feast!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! So, Toya, now that you're here, let us begin our dinner party!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, before we do...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it's just... I have something for the two of you, but I was wondering if I should wait until after dinner...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, you have a surprise for us?
I can't wait to see what you prepared.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I'm not entirely sure what's going on... But let's start our party!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank you very much.
That was delicious...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was?! That's wonderful to hear!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, the beef stew was particularly good...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The beef and vegetables were so soft and slow-cooked to perfection. Also, the broth was rich and filled with so much flavor.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness. By the way, Tsukasa and I made that together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki was in charge of all the frying and stewing, while I was...in charge of washing and chopping the vegetables!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, Toya, how did you like the marinade? Saki did all of that herself, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You did? I liked how the onions' natural spiciness went so well with the lemon juice's refreshing flavor. It was very good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hehe. You're making me blush...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, thank you both very much for this wonderful meal.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had dinner, how does tea sound?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Toya, our mom was given this really amazing tea. I'll go make some now, so just gimme a second!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
Before we do, I have some gifts for the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, the thing you mentioned when you got here? I wanna see! I've been wondering this whole time!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, here they are...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope you enjoy them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, are these...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah! Cupcakes! They look delicious!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? Wait, these look homemade!
Toya, did you bake these?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I hope they're to your liking...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-Whaaat?!
Toya, you know how to bake?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! Is that true?! Thank you so much! I feel super duper extra amazingly happy!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Y-You're welcome...
I'm glad you like them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, Toya, where did you find the time to learn how to bake these...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't bake them all by myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had quite a few people help me as I made mistakes along the way. Luckily, I was able to bake something suitable in the end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see... Just for us...
Thank you for putting so much effort into these.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you two did the same by preparing all this for me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm gonna go get that tea ready now! I want us to have these together...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd like that as well!
Toya, would mind helping me put your cupcakes onto some plates?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, this one has chocolate chips in it... And is this one green tea flavored?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There's so many different kinds!
I'm having fun just looking at them all♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, me too...
Oh! Saki, look! This one has a strawberry on top!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, you're right! I want that one!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, have at it!
However, in return, I'll be taking this blueberry one!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Got it. The blueberry one♪
Which would you like, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I'll have... The one with matcha in it. I made one that isn't too sweet for myself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Alright, I think we all have one now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Let's thank Toya for baking these and...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Dig in!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya, this... This is delicious!
Mind if I try this chocolate chip one as well?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Tsukasa, no fair!
I wanna try it too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then, let's split it!
Here's your half!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really? Thanks, Tsukasa!
Hehe. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Toya, do you want some more tea?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, yes, please...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, this all feels so nostalgic.
It reminds me of the time we had homemade treats when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, yeah! Mom used to bake us stuff all the time back then!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I remember as well.
All the times we played and had these sorts of treats together when we were children...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Each of those moments is beyond precious to me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course, we feel the same way.
That includes today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! You made these delicious cupcakes for us and we got to have them together... I can't think of a better way for us to spend time together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope the three of us get to keep on gathering like this! That would make me sooo happy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As I! It'd be wonderful to be able to spend time together like this no matter how old we get.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that as well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This is so strange...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's like nothing has changed since we were little. Every time I come here, I feel right at home...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I used to feel so lonely back then.
I wasn't sure that there was anyone out there who understood how I felt...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But now, I have a partner, teammates and friends who understand just that... Thanks to them, I rarely ever feel lonely.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But...still...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This feeling of being at ease with myself... It's been keeping me afloat all this time...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I hope the gift I gave today makes up for even a little bit of what they've given me...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't say for sure, but...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that they both enjoyed my gift.)
